create_Column: create a Column object with a name, type, and optional sample value for table schema
create_Table: create a Table object with an id, header columns, and optional row data
tokenize_Table: tokenize all column names, sample values, and row data in a Table using a BertTokenizer
convert_Table_to_dataframe: convert a Table to a pandas DataFrame with optional tokenization or detokenization
copy_Column: create a deep copy of a Column object preserving all attributes and custom fields
